findings.identity_explanation: COM-04 uses tag FCU-507 with Level 5 east wing. The tag format suggests FCU-L5-07 but the location matches FCU-L5-08 (CR:FCU-L5-08 'Level 5 east wing'; CR:FCU-L5-07 is 'Level 5 west wing'). Model CF-12 agrees with both units and the serial is not recorded, so fewer than two attributes can confirm the match and the location points to a different unit (Matching 2.2, 3.1). Not merged. COR-02 from the contractor admits the old tag FCU-507 was used and that they do not know which unit it was.

exceptions.finding: The only commissioning certificate listing the exact tag FCU-L5-07 (COM-12) is a draft with Final approval not signed, so Readiness 2.2 fails.

evidence.quote: Result: Pass | Final approval: Not signed
Draft sheet. Unit tested but wing not recorded. To be re-issued.

exceptions.responsible_party: Brisel MEP Services (installing subcontractor), through Halvorn Contracting
exceptions.next_action: Re-issue COM-12 with the wing and serial recorded and a signed final approval. The promised re-issue is not yet a document (Evidence 2.3).

exceptions.finding: COM-04 (signed, tag FCU-507, Level 5 east wing) cannot be matched to FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08 with confidence. Tag points to 07, location to 08, serial not recorded. The signed approval on COM-04 must not be counted for FCU-L5-07.

exceptions.responsible_party: Halvorn Contracting project manager / Brisel MEP Services
exceptions.next_action: Contractor to verify on site which unit was tested under COM-04 and correct the tag at the next issue. The contractor suggests this may only happen after handover.

exceptions.finding: COM-12 gives only 'Level 5' with no wing, and COM-04 gives east wing; neither confirms the west wing location in the registers for FCU-L5-07. Serial is also not recorded on either certificate.
exceptions.responsible_party: Brisel MEP Services via Halvorn Contracting
exceptions.next_action: Record wing and serial on the re-issued certificate.

findings.summary: FCU-L5-07 is not ready: its commissioning certificate COM-12 is an unsigned draft, and the signed certificate COM-04 uses the old tag FCU-507 with an east wing location, so it cannot be tied to this unit or to FCU-L5-08. The match is uncertain and records are not merged. Warranty, O&M, FM record, PPM and register identity passed the code checks.
findings.escalation_reason: Asset match is uncertain (Escalation 2.2, Matching 3.1): COM-04 tag FCU-507 suggests FCU-L5-07 but location Level 5 east wing suggests FCU-L5-08. The handover manager must decide whether to require on-site verification before the 24 November 2026 handover. Also a critical open exception on commissioning approval.
findings.clarification_to: Halvorn Contracting project manager (for Brisel MEP Services)
findings.clarification_subject: FCU-L5-07 and FCU-L5-08: commissioning certificates COM-12 and COM-04
findings.clarification_body: Please (1) re-issue COM-12 for FCU-L5-07 with the wing and serial recorded and Final approval signed; (2) confirm on site which unit was tested under COM-04, which is tagged FCU-507 and located 'Level 5 east wing', and reissue it with the correct tag and serial; (3) confirm serial numbers for FCU-L5-07 and FCU-L5-08 from the unit plates. We cannot treat either certificate as covering a unit until this is verified. Handover is planned for 24 November 2026.
uncertainties: Which unit COM-04 (FCU-507) actually tested is unknown.
Serial numbers are not recorded on COM-04 or COM-12.
Contractor says verification may happen only after handover.
